QuestInfo.name: Critter Champs
QuestInfo.0: The cat wants to tell you about the Critter Champs.
QuestInfo.1: The cat revealed that he's a member of the Critter Champs, along with three other creatures. He invites you to join them. Tempting! Since you are, after all, a soon-to-be hero. Talk to the cat to join.
QuestInfo.2: You became a member of the Critter Champs. Woohoo! Your very first hero organization!

1.0: Hey, you wanna join us? Great idea! So glad you mentioned it!
